lines.text: Every day, a river of buses and cars climbs these hills to Tirumala, on a road built more than eighty years ago.
lines.tts: Every day, a river of buses and cars climbs these hills to Tirumala... on a road built more than eighty years ago.

lines.text: And here's the strange part. This old road survives every monsoon, while the newer road beside it keeps breaking.
lines.tts: And here's the strange part. This old road survives every monsoon... while the newer road beside it keeps breaking.

lines.text: Before 1944, there was no motor road here. Pilgrims walked, or rode bullock carts up a winding track.
lines.tts: Before nineteen forty-four, there was no motor road here. Pilgrims walked, or rode bullock carts, up a winding track.

lines.text: The plan for a motor road is credited to Sir M. Visvesvaraya, India's legendary engineer. Engineer A. Nageswara Iyer led the work, and Gannon Dunkerley built it.
lines.tts: The plan for a motor road is credited to Sir M. Visvesvaraya, India's legendary engineer. Engineer A. Nageswara Iyer led the work, and Gannon Dunkerley built it.

lines.text: Their smartest decision? They didn't fight the mountain. They followed the old cart track, keeping the slope gentle all the way up.
lines.tts: Their smartest decision? They didn't fight the mountain. They followed the old cart track... keeping the slope gentle, all the way up.

lines.text: Going straight up would be far too steep for any vehicle.
lines.tts: Going straight up, would be far too steep for any vehicle.

lines.text: So wherever the hill turns steep, the road folds back on itself. Hairpin bends. The road gets longer, but every stretch stays gentle.
lines.tts: So wherever the hill turns steep, the road folds back on itself. Hairpin bends. The road gets longer... but every stretch stays gentle.

lines.text: Opened in 1944, this one road carried every vehicle, up and down, for thirty years.
lines.tts: Opened in nineteen forty-four, this one road carried every vehicle, up and down, for thirty years.

lines.text: In 1974, a second road opened for the climb. But between kilometre eleven and seventeen, it was cut steeply through the rock.
lines.tts: In nineteen seventy-four, a second road opened for the climb. But between kilometre eleven and seventeen, it was cut steeply through the rock.

lines.text: That cut left fractured rock behind. In heavy rain, boulders fall, and the road has to close.
lines.tts: That cut left fractured rock behind. In heavy rain, boulders fall... and the road has to close.

lines.text: The old road, laid along the hill's own path, keeps running.
lines.tts: The old road, laid along the hill's own path... keeps running.

lines.text: Same hills. Two roads. Great engineering works with nature, not against it.
lines.tts: Same hills. Two roads. Great engineering works with nature... not against it.
